title: icecast2mqtt configuration
description: Configuration for the icecast2mqtt service. Note: MQTT broker URL, username and password are NOT read from JSON - provide them via environment variables MQTT_BROKER, MQTT_USERNAME and MQTT_PASSWORD.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file. Used by editors for validation and hints; ignored at runtime.

mqtt.description: MQTT connection settings. Credentials are taken from environment variables MQTT_BROKER, MQTT_USERNAME and MQTT_PASSWORD.

client_id.description: MQTT client identifier used when connecting to the broker.

base_topic.description: Base MQTT topic under which each target publishes its data, e.g. "icecast2mqtt".

targets.description: List of Icecast endpoints to poll.

mqtt_topic.description: Sub-topic under base_topic for this source, e.g. "radio".

update_interval.description: Polling interval as a Go duration string, e.g. "5s", "5000ms" or "1h30m".

ha_discovery.description: Optional Home Assistant MQTT discovery configuration. Omit to disable autodiscovery for this source.

device_id.description: Unique device identifier used in Home Assistant discovery topics.

device_name.description: Friendly device name shown in Home Assistant.
